exercises.exercise_description: 1 second pause at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs. After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~6-7 on your early sets and ~7-8 on your last set resting 3-5 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Do one set with low cable position, one set with medium-height cable position, and one height with a high cable position. If you only have one or two sets, choose the one or two cable positions you prefer. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~8-9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

1.5x shoulder width overhand grip. Slow 2-3 second negative. Feel your lats pulling apart on the way down. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~6-7 on your early sets and ~7-8 on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Focus on squeezing your lateral delt to move the weight. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~8-9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Stand on a bumper plate. Focus on getting a big stretch and touch your stomach/chest on each rep! After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~8-9 on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Optionally pause for 0.5-1 second in the stretched aspect of each rep. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~8-9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

If you have a left-right bicep size imbalance, do these 1 arm at a time, starting with the weaker arm. Take the weaker arm to the listed RPE. Then match the reps with the other arm (stop once you've matched the reps, even if the RPE is lower). If you don't have a size imbalance, do these both arms at the same time. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~8-9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Set the machine so that you get the biggest stretch possible at the bottom. Prevent your butt from popping up as you curl. After 2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~8-9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Once you are under the bar, set up your feet as you would a normal squat and then bring them forward ~3-6 inches. This will cause you to lean back into the bar slightly, allowing for a more upright squat, while also placing more tension on the quads. If your heels are raising at the bottom, you may need to bring your feet more forward. If your feet feel like they are slipping or your lower back is rounding at the bottom, try bringing your feet back a bit. After 2-4 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~6-7 on your early sets and ~7-8 on your last set resting 3-5 min between sets. 2 total work sets

To keep tension on the hamstrings, stop about 75% of the way to full lockout on each rep (i.e. stay in the bottom 3/4 of the range of motion). After 2-4 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~6-7 on your early sets and ~7-8 on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Set the seat back as far as it will go while still feeling comfortable. Grab the handles as hard as you can to pull your butt down into the seat. Use a 2-3 second negative. Feel your quads pulling apart on the negative. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~8-9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Instead of just going up onto your toes, think about rolling your ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~8-9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Round your lower back as you crunch. Maintain a mind-muscle connection with your 6-pack. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~8-9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Set up a comfortable arch, quick pause on the chest and explode up on each rep. After 2-4 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~6-7 on your early sets and ~7-8 on your last set resting 3-5 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Ensure that your elbows break at least 90°. Mind-muscle connection with your delts. Smooth, controlled reps. After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~6-7 on your early sets and ~7-8 on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets

All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. Focus on feeling a deep stretch in your pecs at the bottom of each rep. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~8-9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Focus on squeezing your lateral delt to move the weight. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~8-9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Optionally pause for 0.5-1 second in the stretched aspect of each rep. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~8-9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

There are two ways you can do this: upright or bent over. Choose the one that feels more comfortable for you. The main thing is that when you're in the full squeeze, your shoulder should be positioned back behind your torso. After 1 warm-up set, do 1 set of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your set resting 1-2 min between sets. 1 total work set

Allow your lower back to round as you curl your legs up. 10-20 reps is a broad range on purpose: just go until you hit the listed RPE with controlled form. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 10-20 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~8-9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Do these pulldowns with the handle more out in front of you, more like a cross between pullover and a pulldown. Focus on feeling your lats working more than the weight you're using. After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~6-7 on your early sets and ~7-8 on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Flare elbows out at roughly 45° and squeeze your shoulder blades together hard at the top of each rep. After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~6-7 on your early sets and ~7-8 on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 3-5 min between sets. Take your last set to full failure. 3 total work sets

Squeeze your glutes hard at the top of each rep. Slow controlled reps on the way down, followed by an explosive positive. After 2-4 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. Take your last set to full failure. 3 total work sets

Set the seat back as far as it will go while still feeling comfortable. Grab the handles as hard as you can to pull your butt down into the seat. Use a 2-3 second negative. Feel your quads pulling apart on the negative. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. Take your last set to full failure. 3 total work sets

1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Instead of just going up onto your toes, think about rolling your ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. After your last set, hold a 30 second static stretch in the lengthened position. 3 total work sets

Round your lower back as you crunch. Maintain a mind-muscle connection with your 6-pack. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. Take your last set to full failure. 2 total work sets

1 second pause at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs. After 2-4 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 3-5 min between sets. Take your last set to full failure. 3 total work sets

Ensure that your elbows break at least 90°. Mind-muscle connection with your delts. Smooth, controlled reps. After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. Take your last set to full failure. 3 total work sets

All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. Focus on feeling a deep stretch in your pecs at the bottom of each rep. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. Take your last set to full failure. 2 total work sets

Focus on squeezing your lateral delt to move the weight. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. Take your last set to failure, then immediately rest ~15-20 seconds and squeeze out another mini-set; repeat for 2-3 mini-sets (myo-reps). 2 total work sets

Optionally pause for 0.5-1 second in the stretched aspect of each rep. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. Take your last set to full failure. 3 total work sets

Focus on squeezing your triceps to move the weight. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 15-20 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. Take your last set to failure, then immediately rest ~15-20 seconds and squeeze out another mini-set; repeat for 2-3 mini-sets (myo-reps). 2 total work sets

Don't just bend at your hips, use your abs to lower yourself down under control and pull yourself back up. If you don't have the core strength to get all the way extended at the bottom, try to progressively increase the ROM week to week. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. Take your last set to full failure. 2 total work sets

Initiate the pulldown with a straight up posture. As you pull the bar down, lean back by about 15-30° to get the mid-back more involved. Softly touch the bar to your chest on every rep and, even though you're leaning back, still control the weight! After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. Take your last set to full failure. 3 total work sets

Flare elbows out at roughly 45° and squeeze your shoulder blades together hard at the top of each rep. After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. Take your last set to full failure. 3 total work sets

Flare your elbows out ~45°. Smooth, controlled reps. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. Take your last set to failure, then extend it with a few lengthened partial reps (LLPs) in the stretched position until you can't get any more. 2 total work sets

Pause for 1-2 seconds in the squeeze of each rep. Contract the rear delts hard! After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. Take your last set to failure, then immediately rest ~15-20 seconds and squeeze out another mini-set; repeat for 2-3 mini-sets (myo-reps). 3 total work sets

Shrug up and in. Think about shrugging "up to your ears." 1-2 second pause in the squeeze (at the top) of each rep, then another 1-2 second pause in the stretch (at the bottom) of each rep. After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and 10 (full failure) on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. Take your last set to full failure. 2 total work sets
